focusMultiplier.label: Tool Focus Multiplier
focusMultiplier.description: Felling axes and pickaxes give this many times their normal focus per hit (normally 3, so 9 at the default). 1 keeps the game's own value. Restart required.

weaponFocusMultiplier.label: Weapon Focus Multiplier
weaponFocusMultiplier.description: Weapons give this many times their normal focus per hit (normally 3 to 5, so 6 to 10 at the default). Covers every item other than felling axes and pickaxes that gives focus, unarmed hits included. 1 keeps the game's own values. Restart required.

changelog: 1.0.0: first version, a Focus Multiplier setting for the focus felling axes and pickaxes give per hit.
1.0.1: renamed from Tool Focus to Focus Gain. New Weapon Focus Multiplier setting for every other item that gives focus per hit; the tool setting is now called Tool Focus Multiplier.
